peers.name: seo-audit
peers.description: When the user wants to audit or diagnose SEO, or asks why traffic dropped, a page won't rank, or whether a setup like canonicals, hreflang, or redirects is right: technical SEO, indexing, Google updates, on-page and titles, Core Web Vitals, local SEO. Start here when someone just says their SEO is bad. For pages at scale, see programmatic-seo. For structured data, see schema. For AI search, see ai-seo.

peers.name: content-strategy
peers.description: When the user wants to plan content, or asks which topic or piece to prioritize, what to write about, or why posts bring no customers: topic clusters, editorial calendars, roadmaps tied to customers and search. For writing pieces, see copywriting. For SEO audits, see seo-audit. For social content, see social.

peers.name: marketing-psychology
peers.description: When the user wants to apply psychology to marketing, or asks why buyers behave or value things as they do, or whether a persuasion tactic is honest: biases, mental models, anchoring, social proof, scarcity, loss aversion, framing. For a page, see cro. For pricing tactics, see pricing. For copy, see copywriting.

peers.name: ai-seo
peers.description: When the user wants to get cited and recommended in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews), or asks why AI cites a competitor, which content gets cited, or whether llms.txt or a page format is worth it: AEO, GEO, AI visibility, agent-readable sites. For technical and on-page SEO, see seo-audit. For structured data, see schema.

en.tagline: Writes or rewrites web page copy with supportable claims
en.summary: This skill writes or rewrites page copy for homepages, landing pages, pricing pages, and feature pages. It first checks whether the input is a blank brief, a draft with a real voice, or a point edit, and changes only what that situation calls for. It also keeps claims supportable and removes common AI writing patterns.
problem: A page needs copy, or a draft exists but reads as generic AI text. Writers often either start from nothing or rewrite a draft so heavily that its original voice and argument are lost.

With this skill, the copy starts with a diagnosis of the input. Claims that the source material cannot support are not written, and each declined claim names the evidence that would make it usable. Missing proof is marked as [NEED: ...] instead of being invented.
fit: Writing homepage, landing, pricing, or feature page copy from a brief
Rewriting a draft that already has an angle or voice, while keeping its wording and argument
Choosing which headline, promise, or message to lead with
unfit: Line-by-line polishing of existing copy (use the copy-editing skill)
Emails or offers (see the emails and offers skills)
steps: Reads the product marketing context file if one exists, and checks its Learnings section before drafting.
Diagnoses the input as a blank brief, a draft with real voice, or a point edit, and states the diagnosis in one line with the evidence.
Breaks the page into units such as headline, subhead, CTA, and each section, drafts two or three candidates for each, and locks the best one.
Tests each line by asking whether a reader can picture it, whether it can be proven true or false, and whether a competitor could use the same sentence.
Removes AI tells such as contrast reveals, negation lists, and self-answered questions, and flags missing proof with [NEED: ...].
Reverts any change it cannot give a reason for, then returns the copy with annotations and alternatives, or only the changed lines for a point edit.

zh.tagline: 撰写或改写网页文案，只写有依据的主张
zh.summary: 这个技能用于撰写或改写首页、落地页、定价页和功能页的文案。它会先判断输入是空白需求、带有真实语气的草稿，还是局部修改，只改动该情况需要的部分。它还会确保主张有据可依，并去掉常见的AI写作痕迹。
problem: 页面需要文案，或者已有草稿但读起来像通用的AI文字。写作者常常要么从零开始，要么大幅改写草稿，结果原有的语气和论点都丢了。
使用该技能时，文案的第一步是判断输入属于哪种情况。原始材料无法支持的主张不会写入，被拒绝的主张会说明需要什么证据才能使用。缺少的证明会标记为[NEED: ...]，不会凭空编造。
fit: 根据需求撰写首页、落地页、定价页或功能页文案
改写已有角度或语气的草稿，保留其原有措辞和论点
选择首条标题、承诺或信息应当放在最前面
unfit: 对现有文案逐行润色（请使用copy-editing技能）
邮件或优惠内容（请参考emails和offers技能）
steps: 如果存在产品营销背景文件，先读取它，并在动笔前查看其中的Learnings部分。
将输入判定为空白需求、有真实语气的草稿或局部修改，用一行话写出判断及依据。
把页面拆分为标题、副标题、按钮文案以及每个章节等单元，为每个单元写两到三个候选，选出最好的一个并定稿。
对每一行文字提三个问题：读者能否想象出画面，能否被证明真假，竞争对手能否原样使用这句话。
去掉对比式转折、否定列举、自问自答等AI痕迹，对缺失的证明标记[NEED: ...]。
撤销任何说不出理由的改动，然后交付带有注释和备选方案的文案；局部修改时只返回改动的行。
